blocking_findings.finding: The V2 Graph write stores published_at, retrieved_at, filed_at, effective_from and effective_to exactly as GraphDocument string parameters (rag/graph_store.py:428-456), while the frozen traversal compares those stored properties directly with datetime($as_of) (rag/hybrid_rag.py:323-327). The frozen Neo4j contract requires temporal eligibility before traversal. A concrete live counterexample is an otherwise eligible evidence row written with published_at='2026-01-01T00:00:00+00:00': the property is a Neo4j String, but the traversal boundary is a Neo4j DateTime, so the query does not implement the required temporal comparison over like-typed values. Mock assertions that inspect parameter text cannot establish live property typing.
blocking_findings.required_change: Normalize and validate every Graph temporal value once, then persist it as a Neo4j temporal property (for example, null-safe datetime parameter conversion in Cypher) so published_at, retrieved_at, filed_at, effective_from and effective_to have the same temporal type family used by datetime($as_of). Invalid or unknown required time must remain null/quarantined and never become now. Add an offline driver/query-shape test that proves null-safe temporal conversion plus a live Neo4j integration test when separately authorized; retain fail-closed traversal behavior when the contract cannot be enforced.

blocking_findings.finding: AlphaGraphStore.upsert_batch chooses the temporal path only when temporal_identity_complete is true; every other document is sent to the legacy entity/relation MERGE path (rag/graph_store.py:236-250). That fallback is based on missing fields rather than an explicit legacy provenance boundary. Therefore a quarantined or V2-origin document with one missing immutable identity field can update the legacy aggregate relationship, whose ON MATCH behavior averages weight and overwrites temporal meaning (rag/graph_store.py:390-399), instead of being rejected or skipped fail closed. This contradicts the Stage04A temporal/quarantine contract and can contaminate legacy state with incomplete V2 evidence.
blocking_findings.required_change: Introduce an explicit write-mode/provenance boundary. Only documents explicitly identified as legacy input may use the legacy MERGE path. Any V2-origin, temporal, or quarantined document with incomplete immutable identity/time must be skipped or rejected with a stable sanitized code and lifecycle count, without writing entities or relationships to either namespace. Add counterexample tests for quarantined extracted documents, V2-origin documents missing each required identity, and explicit legacy documents to prove fail-closed V2 behavior while preserving intentional legacy compatibility.

blocking_findings.finding: The frozen Stage02 Neo4j write shape explicitly requires every EvidenceObservationV2 observation to store materialized_at (database/neo4j/001_temporal_evidence.cypher:69-75), and the data schema contract requires materialization time when applicable. The Stage04A EvidenceObservationV2 MERGE writes chunk/ticker/dataset and availability/effective/quarantine fields but omits materialized_at entirely (rag/graph_store.py:428-433 and parameter list at 448-456). Consequently a newly created evidence observation cannot satisfy the accepted V2 provenance contract.
blocking_findings.required_change: Carry the canonical Stage03 materialized_at value into GraphDocument and persist it on EvidenceObservationV2 as a validated Neo4j temporal property. Treat a missing required V2 materialization time according to the frozen quarantine/fail-closed policy rather than substituting current time. Add exact write-shape and preservation tests, including retry/idempotency, proving materialized_at is present and unchanged for the same evidence identity.
